author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
The frenzy bonus was not something I even used. Crit damage feels way more consistently strong, and the multi target brings it's damage slightly closer to Yel Staff, which MASSIVELY outshines the GS or Thinblade damage as it is. 

Overall I really like the change. Frenzy is class specific, costs a turn, and you can't use it if you randomly took ward damage the round before making it a challenging buff to time.

author: towelwiper
body:
The frenzy modifier on the yelmogus gear and yggdrasil crucibles only affects spiked shield while frenzied. 

So unless you were building a spiked shield yelmogus greatsword build you aren't negatively affected by this change

author: -SnakeAwakens
body: Very unfortunate the ballista had a reasonable magic stat and they took it away. I have a 199/200 roll and was excited to try it out on my corvus. It has 25% turn reduction removing the need for sequencer to get 100% 1 turn ultima. Maybe their plan is to introduce a caster specific weapon for that or something.
